text:
mira: Heads up — planning to enable ff/cache_batch_v2 tomorrow 09:00 PST across a 10% canary. Quick ops sync?
jonas: I can take pager for the window. Which clusters and audience shards?
sam: perf run looked good on most cases, but called out seq>2048 tail spike. Did we set fallback?
mira: Canary scope = us-west-2 only, pool=dedicated-gpu-prod-2. Audience shards = 3 & 7 (~10%). Guardrails: p99 latency < 250ms, error rate < 0.5%, KV miss delta < +15%. Token-cost delta must stay within [-5%, +10%].
taylor: Nice. I'll run the smoke suite + long-tail probe immediately after toggle. What's the exact rollback criteria?
sam: Short summary from perf: overall latency down ~8% on avg, p95 better, but p99 regresses ~4% for very long sequences. We added a sequence-length cutoff for the new path to fallback.
mira: Runbook snippet: ```# enable canary
curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/flags/ff/cache_batch_v2/enable -d '{"percent":10,"clusters":["us-west-2"]}'
# verify
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=serving --tail=200 | grep cache_batch_v2
# smoke tests
./scripts/smoke_canary.sh --model=gpt-4-local --qps=20 --duration=5m
```
deploy-bot: Canary toggle scheduled by mira for 2025-11-12T09:00:00Z. :calendar:
jonas: Rollback rules I recommend: rollback immediately if p99 > 300ms for a sustained 5m, or error_rate > 1% for 1m, or KV cache miss rate increases >15% vs baseline for 2m. Also rollback on any model integrity failures.
taylor: Acknowledged. I'll monitor traces and run the tail-probe at +5m and +20m. Oncall window for me is 08:45-10:00 PST. :eyes:
sam: Can we enable higher trace sampling for affected models during canary? Need detailed flamegraphs if we see regressions. /cc @eng-sre-bot
jonas: Added routing guard: if node CPU > 80% route traffic to ff/cache_batch_v1 fallback. Also configured a soft-fallback at the load-balancer for 5xx spikes.
eng-sre-bot: Alert policy created: cache_batch_v2_canary_latency (p99 > 280ms, email + pager).
mira: Also adding cost alert: token spend per-minute > +12% from baseline triggers an ops page. If stable for 30m we will ramp to 30% then 60% per runbook.
taylor: I'll post the smoke logs to #eng-runtime after run and tag the rollout PR.
mira: Thanks all — will post final toggle command in 30m and notify infra channel. :shipit:
